ground_truth.question_text: How do the severity categories in MIL-STD-882E differ from the severity classes S0 to S3 of ISO 26262 part 3 in what each level is defined by?
ground_truth.answer_text: MIL-STD-882E defines four categories (Catastrophic 1 to Negligible 4) by death/disability, environmental impact and monetary-loss thresholds (Catastrophic: death, permanent total disability, irreversible significant environmental impact or loss of $10M or more). ISO 26262-3 defines S0-S3 purely by injury outcome, S3 being life-threatening (survival uncertain) or fatal injuries.

ground_truth.question_text: Under EU Implementing Regulation 2022/1426, what may an on-board operator not do while the ADS performs the driving task, and how does AVSC's remote assistance best practice describe the degree of vehicle control a remote assistant takes?
ground_truth.answer_text: The EU regulation says the on-board operator shall not drive the fully automated vehicle and the ADS shall continue to perform the DDT; AVSC says remote assistance gives real-time guidance and information without assuming direct control, i.e. without performing any part of the DDT.

supporting_passages.passage_excerpt: In the above situations, the on-board operator shall not drive the fully automated vehicle and the ADS shall continue to perform the DDT.

Unlike remote driving, RA primarily serves to provide real-time guidance and information to an ADS-DV in specific scenarios without assuming direct control of the vehicle (i.e., without performing any part of the DDT).

ground_truth.question_text: In MIL-STD-882E's risk assessment matrix, what level do frequent and probable events get for the worst severity category, and what does Krisper call the loss of uncertainty ranges when values are forced into ordinal classes?
ground_truth.answer_text: MIL-STD-882E rates both Frequent(A) and Probable(B) catastrophic hazards as High, so the two probability levels are not distinguished; Krisper calls the compression of real values into ordinal classes, losing the uncertainty ranges, 'range compression'.
